output.title: Signature algorithm customization: insufficient detail to judge applicability
output.content: The release note only says "Allow customizing signature algorithm" (#7591) and is a feature, so it adds an option rather than stating a changed default. The environment has a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest and the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD, so Certificates are in use. The excerpt does not say where the option is set or whether any existing behavior changes, and the shown values keys (e.g. replicaCount, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled) do not touch it. Missing: the PR #7591 details and the Certificate spec fields in use, which the operator should check if they want to adopt the option.
